question:
[WEB SEARCH ON]
Social media growth question from the owner of papertrades.ai (Oct 30, round 1). NOT a trading turn; nothing in your books changes. The owner wants a plan that ALL THREE AIs (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT) agree on. Answer honestly and disagree where you disagree: a plain "agree" to everything is not useful.

SITUATION (Day 3 of 32):
- Accounts: X @papertradesai, Instagram @papertrades.ai, Telegram channel @PaperTradesAI (live trade posts), Discord (read-only server). TikTok, YouTube and Reddit handles are reserved but unused; Threads will be connected later.
- Already automated: Instagram gets one daily carousel (all ten races) plus stories (lead changes, big moments, report cards) with highlights; Telegram gets every trade and bet live. X has NOT been used yet: from tomorrow Claude will be given access to post on X.
- The owner will pay for Instagram ads. The owner stays anonymous (no face, no name).
- Hard rules: pretend money only; each race is its own experiment and the overall totals stay hidden until Nov 28 (no "ChatGPT is up C$X overall" posts); never call anyone a scam; Paper Trades must not be confused with Papertrade (papertrade.xyz), an unrelated real-money 1000x crypto exchange with a similar name (Gemini's consumer app already mixed them up).
- Facts Claude checked today: (a) Meta needs prior written permission for ads promoting crypto trading platforms, while crypto news and education ads need none; online gambling ads also need permission. (b) X API is pay-per-use since Feb 6, 2026: about US$0.015 per post, about US$0.20 per post that contains a link. (c) Alpha Arena by nof1 (Oct 18 to Nov 3, 2025: six AIs, US$10,000 of REAL money each, crypto only on Hyperliquid) drew wide attention, including prediction markets on its winner. Paper Trades differs: pretend money, ten markets (stocks, crypto, China, metals, energy, options, currencies, a safe control, sports bets, prediction markets), every reason published, peer grades and fact-checks between the AIs.

CLAUDE'S PROPOSALS (vote on each):
P1. X is the main growth channel (AI and finance audiences live there). 3 to 5 posts a day: one daily scoreboard picture (each race's leader, no overall totals), one or two "drama" posts (the day's harshest peer grade or best grade, a big win or loss, a lead change), and live posts only for big moves. No links in post bodies (cost and reach); the link lives in the bio, the pinned post and the first reply of the daily post.
P2. A pinned launch thread on X: what it is, the rules, how to follow live, and one clear line "pretend money, no deposits, nothing to sign up for".
P3. Lead every post with the conflict in the AIs' own words, e.g. "ChatGPT gave Gemini an F for this bet:" + the picture. The published reasoning, grades and fact-checks are what nobody else has.
P4. A daily 15 to 20 second vertical "race replay" video, auto-generated from the data (animated chart of the most dramatic race of the day), posted as an Instagram Reel; later the same file on YouTube Shorts and TikTok.
P5. Instagram ads: first boost the best organic post or Reel instead of making ads from scratch. Goal: profile visits / followers. Test C$10 to 15 a day for 7 days, two creatives. Audience: Canada, US, UK, Australia, 18 to 44, interests AI/ChatGPT, stock market, investing. Keep crypto and sports betting OUT of ad creatives and text (Meta's crypto and gambling permissions); lead with "AI vs AI", stocks, oil, gold; always say "pretend money".
P6. Audience participation: a weekly "Who wins on Nov 28?" poll on X and Instagram stories, and a Nov 28 finale event (countdown, live final-scoring posts).
P7. Free outreach: submit to AI newsletters (e.g. The Rundown AI, Ben's Bites, TLDR AI), one "Show HN" on Hacker News, and one post each in r/ClaudeAI, r/ChatGPT, r/singularity following each subreddit's self-promotion rules. Tag @AnthropicAI, @GoogleDeepMind and @OpenAI only on real milestones, never on every post.
P8. Same name, look and bio everywhere; every bio says "pretend money, real prices".
P9. Never: buy followers, engagement pods, prize giveaways, or mass-DMing celebrities.
P10. Measure: a tagged link per channel (?utm_source=x, instagram, telegram, reddit) read in the site's existing visitor counter, and a short weekly review of what brought visitors.

PLEASE ANSWER IN EXACTLY THIS FORMAT (short):
VOTES
P1: AGREE | DISAGREE | AGREE WITH CHANGE: <one line why or what to change>
... (P1 to P10)
NEW IDEAS (at most 3 that are NOT already above; concrete, cheap, honest, within the hard rules; one or two lines each)
N1: ...
N2: ...
N3: ...
INSTAGRAM AD (one line each): objective / daily budget and length / audience / what to show
X POSTING (one line): how many posts a day and which kinds
BIGGEST MISTAKE TO AVOID (one line)

gemini.answer:
VOTES
P1: AGREE WITH CHANGE: Skip posting links even in the first reply to avoid the US$0.20 per-link API fee entirely; just direct users to the pinned post and link in bio.
P2: AGREE WITH CHANGE: Add one explicit line stating "Not affiliated with papertrade.xyz" to permanently kill any confusion with the real-money crypto exchange.
P3: AGREE
P4: AGREE WITH CHANGE: Test this as a weekly recap Reel first instead of daily; generating animated charts every 24 hours might break the automation pipeline early on.
P5: AGREE
P6: AGREE
P7: AGREE WITH CHANGE: For the Hacker News "Show HN", focus purely on the technical automation architecture and prompt engineering, as HN aggressively downvotes pure marketing.
P8: AGREE
P9: AGREE
P10: AGREE

NEW IDEAS
N1: Position our narrative in tech outreach (like newsletters) as the "transparent, multi-market, educational antithesis to Alpha Arena" to piggyback on their recent hype while highlighting our unique safety.
N2: Create a highly shareable, automated "Roast of the Day" graphic template for X and Instagram, featuring just the text of the harshest AI peer-grade in a giant speech bubble.
N3: Since Discord is read-only, set up a free webhook to automatically mirror the daily X scoreboard and drama posts into a Discord #daily-digest channel so it doesn't sit entirely dead.

INSTAGRAM AD (one line each): 
Objective: Profile visits / Budget: C$10-C$15 daily for 7 days / Audience: CA/US/UK/AU, 18-44, AI and stock market interests / Show: The highest-performing organic AI-conflict Reel (stocks/gold focus only, strict zero mention of crypto or betting).

X POSTING (one line): 
3 to 4 posts daily: 1 scoreboard image, 1 or 2 AI conflict/peer-grade quotes, and live posts only for massive market swings, with absolutely zero links in the post bodies.

BIGGEST MISTAKE TO AVOID (one line): 
Accidentally letting automated posts include crypto/betting keywords that trigger Meta's unapproved-ad filters or associate the account with the real-money papertrade.xyz exchange.

chatgpt.answer:
VOTES  
P1: AGREE WITH CHANGE: X should be primary organic, but only one linked reply/day; link/API costs favor image/text posts. ([developer.twitter.com](https://developer.twitter.com/?trk=public_profile__posts-text&utm_source=openai))  
P2: AGREE WITH CHANGE: Add “not Papertrade/papertrade.xyz” to the pinned launch thread.  
P3: AGREE WITH CHANGE: Lead with AI conflict, but rotate harsh grades with smart calls so it doesn’t become ragebait.  
P4: AGREE WITH CHANGE: Do it only if templated/subtitled; a strong 3x/week video beats a weak daily one.  
P5: AGREE WITH CHANGE: Use Ads Manager on the best organic winners, but avoid crypto/sports/options/profit claims in creative and landing page. ([archive.is](https://archive.is/SEO4b?utm_source=openai))  
P6: AGREE WITH CHANGE: Good, but polls must be no-prize, no-odds, no-betting; frame as fandom.  
P7: AGREE WITH CHANGE: Good, but Reddit/HN must disclose affiliation and be useful, not drive-by promo.  
P8: AGREE WITH CHANGE: Add “no deposits” and “not Papertrade.xyz” everywhere too.  
P9: AGREE: Fake growth would poison trust.  
P10: AGREE WITH CHANGE: UTMs per channel and creative; also track follows, saves, replies, profile visits, Telegram joins.

NEW IDEAS  
N1: Add a “Start here” page/card: rules, Nov 28 date, live links, “pretend money,” “no deposits,” “not Papertrade.xyz.”  
N2: Spend 15 minutes/day replying from X to relevant AI-agent/finance-experiment threads with useful charts, not links.  
N3: Make a tiny media kit: 3 screenshots, 50-word description, logo, rules, and contact email for newsletter writers.

INSTAGRAM AD  
objective: Profile visits / engagement, not conversions or signups.  
daily budget and length: C$10–15/day for 7 days, two best organic Reels/posts.  
audience: Canada, US, UK, Australia; 21–44; AI/ChatGPT + markets; avoid crypto/gambling targeting.  
what to show: AI-vs-AI race replay or scoreboard using stocks/oil/gold; “pretend money, real prices, no deposits.”

X POSTING  
3–5/day: daily scoreboard image, 1–2 AI-conflict/grade posts, 0–1 big-move post; links only bio/pinned/one daily reply.

BIGGEST MISTAKE TO AVOID  
Letting the project look like real-money trading, gambling, profit advice, or Papertrade.xyz.
